_doc: The common ring and amulet kinds (bug bash 3.3.2, armour plan section 8; src/rings.py).
A common ring or amulet is one of these kinds at an enchantment level 1-10 rolled when it is
found (gear.roll_level, the same bells as armour): tier = ceil(level / 2) is its quiz tier and
sets its ladder; odd levels are the tier's lesser form, even levels the greater, as for the
minor-slot enchantments. A blessed ring works a level higher, a cursed one a level lower.
No ring or amulet gives AC (section 8: a +1 AC ring outclasses every other ring).
Protection and Spell Turning are priced by tools/balance/armor_model.py (section 8: each
ladder is fitted to the same per-tier budget as a slot enchantment, 0.39-0.59 AC points).
The rest are not harm guards, so the model cannot price them; their ladders rise by tier
on the hook each already had (regeneration, hunger, spell cost, life saving, a stat).
The powers armour now owns left the rings: telepathy, sight, haste, levitation,
displacement, warning, searching, STR / DEX / PER, the elements (data/enchantments.json).

protection.name: Protection
protection.text: a saving throw against every attack: shrugs off {pct} of its poison, fear, sleep, paralysis or any other rider

spell_turning.name: Spell Turning
spell_turning.text: turns aside {pct} of magic, shadow and psionic damage

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.text: mends about {pct} of your health every hundred turns

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.text: makes you invisible; the veil slips when you strike and settles again after {n} quiet turns

sustenance.name: Sustenance
sustenance.text: your hunger comes on {pct} more slowly

life_saving.name: Life Saving
life_saving.text: once, a killing blow leaves you standing with {pct} of your health; then it is spent
